en_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Added Fast Travel Before Devs Decided It Never Needed It in the First Place
cn_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time重制版曾加入快速旅行，开发者后来认定它从一开始就不需要这一功能
opus_summary: Eiji Aonuma透露，他曾要求团队在《The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time》重制版中加入传送点，但试玩后发现这会让玩家错过沿途探索的发现，于是决定全部移除。重制版加入了冲刺和独立跳跃按键，将于11月5日登陆Switch 2。

paragraphs.en: The Legend of Zelda producer Eiji Aonuma asked the Ocarina of Time remake team to add fast travel warp points throughout Hyrule, but it didn't take long for him to realize that was probably a bad idea.
paragraphs.cn: The Legend of Zelda制作人Eiji Aonuma曾要求Ocarina of Time重制版团队在Hyrule各处加入快速旅行传送点，但没过多久，他就意识到这可能是个坏主意。

paragraphs.en: Aonuma, one of the franchise's most experienced developers, touched on the trashed concept as part of an Ask the Developer interview shared by Nintendo today. The Nintendo Switch 2 version of one of the most influential video games of all time already seems to have made a few changes to its gameplay formula, but there's one change that he said was better left on the cutting room floor.
paragraphs.cn: Aonuma是该系列经验最丰富的开发者之一，他在Nintendo今天分享的一篇Ask the Developer采访中谈到了这个被放弃的构想。这款史上最具影响力的电子游戏之一的Switch 2版本，似乎已经对其玩法模式做出了一些改动，但他说有一项改动还是删掉为好。

paragraphs.en: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time players and speedrunners have spent who knows how much time making Link forward roll to quickly cross great distances. When looking back at how the series has evolved with entries like Breath of the Wild, Aonuma said he found room for improvement, pointing to the wide-open (and iconic) Hyrule Field as one location that might benefit from a fast-travel option.
paragraphs.cn: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time的玩家和速通玩家不知花了多少时间让Link向前翻滚，以便快速穿越漫长的路程。回顾该系列如何通过Breath of the Wild等作品发展演变时，Aonuma说他发现了一些可以改进的地方，并指出广阔的Hyrule Field（也是标志性地点）或许能从快速旅行选项中受益。

paragraphs.en: It sounds like it didn't take too long to realize that maybe Nintendo got it right the first time around, though.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，听起来他们没过多久就意识到，或许Nintendo第一次就做对了。

paragraphs.en: "So I asked the team to add warp points that didn’t exist in the original game, giving players access to shortcuts," he explained. "But when we actually tried playing the game with those warp points, we realized that we were missing out on the moments of discovery that came from stopping along the way and wondering, 'Wait, what’s this?'
paragraphs.cn: 他解释道：「所以我让团队加入原版游戏中不存在的传送点，让玩家能够走捷径。但当我们实际尝试游玩加入了这些传送点的游戏时，我们意识到，我们错过了那些在途中停下脚步、心想『等等，这是什么？』时发现新事物的时刻。

paragraphs.en: "Through this development process, we were reminded once again just how important those moments are to the very structure of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. So even though I was the one who proposed adding warp points, they just weren't working for me in the end, so I got the team to take them all back out again. (Laughs)"
paragraphs.cn: 「通过这次开发过程，我们再次意识到，那些时刻对The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time的整体结构有多么重要。所以尽管是我提议加入传送点的，但最终我觉得它们行不通，于是我让团队把它们全部移除了。（笑）」

paragraphs.en: That's not to say Nintendo didn't find room to experiment with the structure of Link's first real 3D adventure. Although, for example, the development team intentionally chose to keep loading screens to preserve the feeling of entering a new area, we already know that Link will be able to move faster thanks to a sprint feature. Players can also now take advantage of a dedicated jump button. What might sound like negligible adjustments to some might be earth-shaking changes for others, but we'll have to wait to see just how different The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake on Switch 2 is from the original.
paragraphs.cn: 这并不是说Nintendo没有找到余地，对Link的首次真正的3D冒险的结构进行尝试。例如，尽管开发团队有意选择保留加载画面，以维持进入新区域的感觉，但我们已经知道，Link将能借助冲刺功能移动得更快。玩家现在也可以使用专门的跳跃按钮。对一些人来说听起来微不足道的调整，对另一些人来说或许是翻天覆地的变化，但我们还得等一等，才能看到Switch 2上的The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time重制版与原版究竟有多大不同。

paragraphs.en: "Looking at what they ultimately created, I’m impressed by how rich an experience they were able to craft from a game that first came out 28 years ago," Aonuma added. "At the beginning of development, I remember thinking, 'They could be making more changes.' But as the project went on, it really came across just how deeply this development team cared about the original game, far more than we had imagined."
paragraphs.cn: Aonuma补充道：「看着他们最终做出的成果，他们能够以一款28年前首次推出的游戏为基础，打造出如此丰富的体验，让我印象深刻。我记得在开发之初，我曾想过，『他们本可以做出更多改动。』但随着项目推进，我们确实感受到了这个开发团队对原版游戏有多么在乎，远远超出了我们的想象。」

paragraphs.en: IGN gathered a list of 40 changes we noticed after getting a better look at the remake in September. We then took a closer look with a preview of our own . If you're wondering why Nintendo opted to make an Ocarina of Time remake in the first place, you can click here .
paragraphs.cn: IGN在9月更深入地了解这款重制版后，整理了一份我们注意到的40项改动清单。之后，我们通过自己的前瞻进一步进行了了解。如果你好奇Nintendo当初为何选择制作Ocarina of Time重制版，可以点击这里。

paragraphs.en: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake launches for Switch 2 November 5. Google is celebrating the release with a time-travling Easter Egg .
paragraphs.cn: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time重制版将于11月5日在Switch 2上发售。Google正以一个时间旅行彩蛋庆祝其发售。
